findings.title: PUT /api/v1/cart/items/1 accepts negative integer quantity and persists negative totals
findings.expected: CART-2 requires negative quantities to return 400 and leave the cart unchanged.
findings.actual: Source trace: quantity -1 passes type(quantity) is int and the upper stock bound, reaches assignment, and is returned through HTTP 200. For baseline Alice this predicts quantity -1, totalItems -1, totalPrice -12. No request was executed.
findings.impact: Code demonstrates invalid cart state and negative displayed aggregate values are possible through the scoped update route. Runtime reachability and user impact have not been exercised.

risks.area: Negative quantity rejection and mutation atomicity
risks.reason: Missing lower-bound guard in app/domain.py:24-36; existing tests omit negatives. Highest priority because an authenticated normal update path writes invalid state.
risks.next_probe: Execute evidence/reproduction.txt on the matching runtime; require 400 and unchanged Alice/Bob/catalog state.

risks.reason: Handler maps exact public fixture tokens to actor and passes actor to per-user carts; normal domain test checks Bob after Alice update. HTTP auth, anonymous, and invalid-token paths are unexecuted.
risks.next_probe: GET and PUT as Alice/Bob/anonymous/invalid token; compare complete cart snapshots and confirm rejected requests do not mutate either identity.

risks.reason: Exact int check rejects bool, null, strings and fractions; >stock rejection precedes assignment and has one domain assertion. Zero removes the item. None is runtime-verified.
risks.next_probe: From a fresh disposable fixture test missing/null/false/string/fraction/-1/1/5/6; check full state after failures and constant stock after success. Test zero last only when owner can reset fixture.

risks.reason: app/domain.py:21 hardcodes 12 rather than reading catalog price; it matches the sole current product, so no current fixture discrepancy is established.
risks.next_probe: Verify quantities 1 and 5 give totals 12 and 60 against GET products. If mutable-price support is later in scope, add a domain test with changed catalog price.

risks.reason: ThreadingHTTPServer exposes a shared Store; the visible lock protects audit writes only. No concurrency tests were inspected, and no failure has been demonstrated.
risks.next_probe: With a resettable fixture and agreed semantics, overlap updates/removal and inspect responses plus final cart; avoid claiming a race defect without evidence.
